hook.text: Odin sacrificed his own eye for wisdom, hanging himself from a tree for nine days to learn the runes.

buildup.text: He was king of the gods but preferred knowledge over power, wandering the worlds disguised as a traveler.

discovery.text: Two ravens, Huginn and Muninn, flew across the world each day and whispered everything they saw to him.

twist.text: Despite all his wisdom, Odin knew he would die at Ragnarök. He prepared for it rather than trying to stop it.

climax.text: He spent eternity gathering warriors and knowledge, all for a battle he knew he could not win.

punchline.text: The wisest god chose to face doom, not flee from it.

quiz.question: What did Odin sacrifice to gain wisdom?
options: His voice for a hundred years
